A_problem_statement.symptom: SP-2 (function rename) invariance is broken in the current system because function identity is based on raw function names stored in genome keys and call-graph edges.
A_problem_statement.root_cause: Function names are used directly as identity tokens. A rename changes the key even though the function's structure, behaviour, and position in the call graph are unchanged.
A_problem_statement.scope: Static/structural identity only. This module does not replace dynamic tracing — it provides a rename-safe structural fingerprint for function alignment before dynamic comparison.
A_problem_statement.relationship_to_v5: Complements StateTransitionGenome (g_T). g_T is rename-invariant at the transition level (uses func_idx). g_ID provides static pre-alignment: given two programs A and B, identify which function in A corresponds to which function in B before tracing.

fields.param_count: int — number of formal parameters (positional + keyword-only)
fields.has_return_value: bool — at least one non-bare return statement
fields.n_recursive_calls: int — structural self-call count (by name within body; approximation)
fields.has_nested_loop: bool — a loop that directly contains another loop
fields.has_exception_handler: bool — any Try or ExceptHandler node
fields.literal_types: str — sorted CSV of Python types of literal constants (no values)
fields.builtin_calls: str — sorted CSV of builtin function names called
fields.body_structure_hash: str — SHA-256[:8] of AST node-type sequence (no names, no values)
fields.n_module_fn_calls: int — count of calls to other top-level functions (count only, no names stored)

invariance_proofs.variable_rename: No variable Name nodes appear in body_structure_hash walk. Integer/bool fields are name-free. INVARIANT by construction.
invariance_proofs.function_rename: Function name is not stored in any fingerprint field. body_structure_hash walks body statements only. n_recursive_calls uses name only as a local counter, not stored. INVARIANT by construction.
invariance_proofs.parameter_rename: Param names never stored. param_count is count only. body_structure_hash omits arg Name nodes. INVARIANT by construction.
invariance_proofs.comment_whitespace: ast.parse strips comments and normalises whitespace before the walk. INVARIANT by construction.
invariance_proofs.dead_code_insertion: Each function fingerprinted independently. Inserting an unrelated function does not affect others' fingerprints. INVARIANT by construction.

C_body_structure_hash.algorithm: Walk all AST nodes reachable from the function body (in field order, depth-first). Emit only the class name of each node (e.g. 'If', 'BinOp', 'Return'). Join with '/'. SHA-256 the UTF-8 byte string. Take first 8 hex characters.
C_body_structure_hash.collision_probability: 2^-32 at 8 hex chars. Acceptable for program-scale matching (typical modules have <100 functions). Extendable to 16 chars if needed.
C_body_structure_hash.example: def f(x): if x > 0: return x  →  'If/Compare/Name/Constant/Gt/Return/Name'  (Name ids not included, only the node type 'Name')

D_similarity_function.strategy: Weighted sum of per-field similarity scores, normalised by total weight.
D_similarity_function.integer_field_score: 1 - |a - b| / max(a, b)  (returns 1.0 when both are 0)

E_matching_algorithm.function: match_functions(fps_a, fps_b, threshold=0.4) → List[(idx_a, idx_b, score)]
steps: 2. Filter to pairs with score >= threshold.
4. Iterate: greedily assign best unmatched pair from each side.
5. Return matched triples sorted by descending score.
E_matching_algorithm.complexity: O(|A| × |B| × log(|A||B|)) — suitable for module-scale programs
E_matching_algorithm.threshold_rationale: 0.4 balances recall (match renamed functions) vs precision (reject unrelated functions). Functions with identical structure score 1.0.

fields.call_graph: Dict[int, List[int]] — index of caller → list of callee indices. Names not stored.
fields.root_index: int — index of root function (not called by any other)
fields.program_hash: str — SHA-256[:16] of sorted body_structure_hashes. Rename-invariant program identifier.

root_selection.primary: Function not appearing as a callee of any other module-level function.
root_selection.tiebreak: If multiple roots: (lowest n_branches, highest param_count) — purely structural.
root_selection.fallback: If all functions form a cycle, root_index = 0.

F_program_identity.program_hash_construction: Sort all body_structure_hashes lexicographically, join with '|', SHA-256, take first 16 hex chars. Invariant to function order and all renames.

tests: T05 loop vs no-loop → different has_loop
T07 match_functions aligns renamed program functions
T09 dead-code insertion doesn't change other fingerprints
T10 comment insertion doesn't change fingerprint
T11 program_hash is stable across renames

H_implementation.dependencies: stdlib only — ast, hashlib, collections, itertools, dataclasses, typing
